subject: [PATCH v2 02/10] mm/madvise: factor shared LRU folio handling

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch refactors shared LRU folio handling in the Linux kernel's mm/madvise module to reduce code duplication and improve maintainability. It extracts common filtering and LRU operation logic into helper functions, making it easier to manage page-table-specific control flow. The patch also renames a function parameter for consistency and removes redundant parentheses from a file pageout check. No functional changes are intended by this refactoring effort.
